"""Verify separate actual data units and all2000 masks using171 new independent masks."""
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v2';plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
status=read(root/'status-v1.json');assert status['status']=='completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review' and not live(status['owner'])
legacy=read(plan['cache']['path']);candidate=read(plan['candidate_cache']['path']);training=read(root/'train-result-v1.json')
data_audit=read(root/'data-input-audit-v1.json');oracle_binding=data_audit['independent_V162_mask_oracle'];assert ref(oracle_binding['path'])==oracle_binding;oracle=read(oracle_binding['path'])
assert len(training['trace'])==len(legacy['batches'])==len(candidate['batches'])==1000
records=[];units=defaultdict(list);masks=defaultdict(list);unit_changed=0
for row,old,new,control_mask,fine_mask,fine_units in zip(training['trace'],legacy['batches'],candidate['batches'],oracle['rows'],data_audit['mask_records'],data_audit['unit_records'],strict=True):
 step=row['step'];assert step==old['step']==new['step']==control_mask['step']==fine_mask['step']==fine_units['step']
 assert row['batch']==old['arrays'] and row['candidate_batch']==new['arrays'] and row['candidate_parent']==new['parent']
 adc=old['metadata']['noise']['shot']==old['metadata']['noise']['read']==0;actual={}
 for arm,item,mask_key,expected_mask in [('legacy-control',old,'flat_target_mask',control_mask),('fine-mesh',new,'candidate_flat_target_mask',fine_mask)]:
  c=row['arms'][arm];variance=np.asarray(item['metadata']['sensor'].get('increment_mean_variance',[]),dtype=np.float32)
  unit=np.maximum(np.sqrt(variance),np.float32(2/65535)).reshape(-1,1,1,1)
  assert fingerprint(unit)==c['pair_unit_values'] and c['pair_unit_floor_DN16']==2
  if arm=='fine-mesh':assert fingerprint(unit)==fine_units['values']
  for field in ['values','eligible_pixels','total_pixels','per_image_eligible_pixels']:assert row[mask_key][field]==expected_mask[field]
  if adc:assert c['loss']==c['gradient_norm']==0
  if unit.size:units[arm,row['domain'],adc].extend(unit.ravel().tolist())
  masks[arm,row['domain'],adc].append(row[mask_key])
  actual[arm]={'units_FP32':unit.ravel().tolist(),'unit_values':fingerprint(unit),'mask':row[mask_key]}
 unit_changed+=actual['legacy-control']['unit_values']!=actual['fine-mesh']['unit_values']
 records.append({'step':step,'domain':row['domain'],'ADC_only':adc,'arms':actual})
unit_groups=[{'arm':arm,'domain':domain,'ADC_only':adc,'pairs':len(values),
 'unit_DN16_median_p90_max':np.quantile(np.array(values,dtype=np.float64)*65535,[.5,.9,1]).tolist(),
 'common_error_unit_DN16':16,'common_error_total_weight':0 if adc else 1} for (arm,domain,adc),values in units.items()]
mask_groups=[{'arm':arm,'domain':domain,'ADC_only':adc,'batches':len(values),
 'mean_batch_fraction':float(np.mean([v['eligible_pixels']/v['total_pixels'] for v in values])),
 'pixel_weighted_fraction':sum(v['eligible_pixels'] for v in values)/sum(v['total_pixels'] for v in values)} for (arm,domain,adc),values in masks.items()]
assert len(unit_groups)==12 and len(mask_groups)==20
output=root/'training-unit-audit-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'pass1000-joint-unit-records-and2000-actual-mask-records','training':ref(root/'train-result-v1.json'),
 'control_cache':plan['cache'],'candidate_cache':plan['candidate_cache'],'candidate_input_mask_audit':ref(root/'data-input-audit-v1.json'),
 'independent_V162_mask_oracle':oracle_binding,'independent_unit_records':1000,'actual_unit_fingerprints_checked':2000,
 'actual_mask_fingerprints_checked':2000,'control_inherited_masks':1000,'candidate_inherited_masks':829,'new_candidate_masks':171,
 'new_independent_mask_computations':171,'unit_arrays_differing_batches':unit_changed,
 'rows':records,'unit_groups':unit_groups,'mask_groups':mask_groups,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
 'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,'scope':'Both arms use the identical2DN16-floor rule,with actual variance values following their respective data. Independent NumPy FP32 reconstruction checks1000 joint records/2000 fingerprints. All1000 control masks replay the old independent oracle. Candidate masks match171 newly independent streaming-extrema computations plus829 inherited unchanged targets. No unavailable full training output loss recomputation,inference-flatness/confidence or quality guarantee.'})
print('PASS2000 actual unit fingerprints and2000 masks;171 newly independent/1829 inherited mask records;changed unit batches',unit_changed)
